class.name: AgentValidator
class.brief_description: Checks a project's scripts, scenes and resources and groups errors by root cause.
class.description: Validates every script (first parse error per file), every scene and resource dependency (missing files, unknown UIDs that only load through their fallback path) and resource loading. An error in a shared file is reported once, with the files it breaks in [code]affected[/code]. Used by [code]--validate-project[/code]. [codeblock] var result = AgentValidator.new().validate_project() print(AgentValidator.format_text(result)) [/codeblock]

method.name: format_text
method.description: Formats a result from [method validate_project] as a short report: one summary line, then one line per diagnostic, at most [param max_diagnostics] ([code]0[/code] for all). If [param errors_only] is [code]true[/code], warnings are left out.

method.name: validate_paths
method.description: Like [method validate_project], but only for the given files.

method.name: validate_project
method.description: Checks every script, scene and resource under [code]res://[/code], skipping hidden folders, folders with a [code].gdignore[/code] file and [code]res://script_templates[/code]. Returns a [Dictionary] with [code]ok[/code], [code]errors[/code], [code]warnings[/code], [code]files[/code] and [code]diagnostics[/code] (each with [code]code[/code], [code]severity[/code], [code]path[/code], optional [code]line[/code]/[code]column[/code], [code]message[/code] and [code]affected[/code]).
